activities.title: Let the child lead a book
activities.materials: Use ordinary household items named in the variant; large, intact, age-rated items only.
activities.safety: Adult supervision throughout. Keep small parts and older siblings’ materials away from younger children. Adapt to current mobility, comfort and access needs; stop when interest ends.
activities.attribution: Original caregiver adaptation informed by the linked guidance; not a tested intervention or a milestone assessment.

variants.instructions: Notice a picture the baby looks at; name it and pause for a look, sound or gesture.
Offer two pictures to choose from; expand the child’s word or gesture into a short phrase.
Wonder together what a character might do next; accept a story or a gesture instead of quizzing.
Take turns retelling a favorite scene or inventing another ending; writing is optional.

variants.instructions: Explore one large unbreakable cup with an adult; name in and out while you demonstrate.

Compare two table arrangements and explain different ways to count the same cups.

variants.instructions: Copy the baby’s sound or gentle hand tap and wait; the baby need not clap.

Make two patterns, trade leaders, and try a quiet/loud variation.
